definitions.en: n. (astronomy) any of the nine large celestial bodies in the solar system that revolve around the sun and shine by reflected light; Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, and Pluto in order of their proximity to the sun; viewed from the constellation Hercules, all the planets rotate around the sun in a counterclockwise direction
definitions.zh: n. 行星, 命运星辰, 杰出的人, 重大影响的事

examples.en: Earth is the third planet from the sun.
examples.zh: 地球是离太阳第三近的行星。

examples.en: Mars is often called the Red Planet.
examples.zh: 火星常被称为红色行星。

definitions.en: n. a body having finite mass and internal structure but negligible dimensions
definitions.zh: n. 颗粒, 粒子, 质点, 极小量

definitions.en: n. a function word that can be used in English to form phrasal verbs
definitions.zh: [化] 粒子; 质点

examples.en: A particle of dust floated in the air.
examples.zh: 一粒灰尘漂浮在空气中。

examples.en: Scientists study the particle's movement.
examples.zh: 科学家研究粒子的运动。

definitions.en: n. a proposal intended to explain certain facts or observations
definitions.zh: n. 假设

definitions.en: n. a tentative insight into the natural world; a concept that is not yet verified but that if true would explain certain facts or phenomena
definitions.zh: [化] 假设

examples.en: The scientist tested her hypothesis with experiments.
examples.zh: 科学家用实验检验了她的假设。

examples.en: We need to prove or disprove this hypothesis.
examples.zh: 我们需要证明或反驳这个假设。

definitions.en: n. (physics and chemistry) the simplest structural unit of an element or compound
definitions.zh: n. 分子, 些微
[化] 分子

examples.en: A water molecule has two hydrogen atoms.
examples.zh: 一个水分子有两个氢原子。

examples.en: Scientists study the structure of the molecule.
examples.zh: 科学家研究分子的结构。

definitions.en: n. the science of matter; the branch of the natural sciences dealing with the composition of substances and their properties and reactions
definitions.zh: n. 化学, 化学过程

definitions.en: n. the chemical composition and properties of a substance or object
definitions.zh: [化] 化学

examples.en: I study chemistry at school.
examples.zh: 我在学校学习化学。

examples.en: They have great chemistry together.
examples.zh: 他们之间有很好的化学反应。

definitions.en: n. the science of matter and energy and their interactions
definitions.zh: n. 物理学, 物理过程, 物理现象

definitions.en: n. the physical properties, phenomena, and laws of something
definitions.zh: [化] 物理; 物理学

examples.en: She studies physics at the university.
examples.zh: 她在大学学习物理学。

examples.en: Physics explains how things move.
examples.zh: 物理学解释物体如何运动。

definitions.en: n. the amount per unit size
definitions.zh: n. 密度
[化] 密度

examples.en: The population density is high in cities.
examples.zh: 城市的人口密度很高。

examples.en: Water has a higher density than air.
examples.zh: 水的密度比空气高。

definitions.en: n. (physics and chemistry) the smallest component of an element having the chemical properties of the element
definitions.zh: n. 原子, 核能, 微粒, 微量

definitions.en: n. (nontechnical usage) a tiny piece of anything
definitions.zh: [计] 原子

examples.en: An atom is the smallest part of matter.
examples.zh: 原子是物质的最小部分。

examples.en: Water is made of two hydrogen atoms.
examples.zh: 水由两个氢原子组成。

definitions.en: n. (physics) the force of attraction between all masses in the universe; especially the attraction of the earth's mass for bodies near its surface
definitions.zh: n. 地心引力, 重力

definitions.en: n. a solemn and dignified feeling
definitions.zh: [化] 重力

examples.en: Gravity pulls objects toward the Earth.
examples.zh: 重力把物体拉向地球。

examples.en: He spoke with gravity about the problem.
examples.zh: 他严肃地谈论这个问题。

definitions.en: n. the science that studies living organisms
definitions.zh: n. 生物学

definitions.en: n. characteristic life processes and phenomena of living organisms
definitions.zh: [化] 生物; 生物学

examples.en: She studies biology at university.
examples.zh: 她在大学学习生物学。

examples.en: Biology helps us understand living things.
examples.zh: 生物学帮助我们理解生物。

definitions.en: s capable of being seen or noticed
definitions.zh: a. 可遵守的, 可庆祝的, 看得见的, 可辨别的, 观测得到的, 值得注意的, 显著的
n. 感觉到的事物, 现象

examples.en: The change is observable to everyone.
examples.zh: 这个变化对每个人都是可观察的。

examples.en: Observable data helps in analysis.
examples.zh: 可观察的数据有助于分析。
